label: Update gate rises at D2 after choosing a2 and when evidence says S2 is good.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo * ep_dec
explanation: Raw z of unit 7 is near zero at D1, small at GO and large at D2, growing over the episode (timing R^2 0.72). Beyond timing it is an S2/a2 signal at D2: higher when the just-made choice is a2 (observed at D2) and when the ideal observer log-odds favour S2 being good (negative belief_lo), lower for a1 / S1-good. At GO it is slightly raised after a previous a2 choice, increasingly late in the episode. The free fit adds the reached state (S2 raises it), a negative effect of the previous a2 at D2, and episode-progress scaling of the D2 effects, for a small gain (dev 0.72 vs 0.69). No future variables used; this reward/transition do not matter.

issues: The recorded short form is beaten by a simpler and clearer one. On test, '(phase == D2) * belief ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 1)' gets 0.748 beyond timing, against 0.679 for the recorded form. The observed-only reference ceiling is 0.82.

belief_lo is the wrong shape. The belief residual at D2 is sigmoidal: about +0.19 in deciles 0-3, a sharp flip at deciles 4-5, then about -0.19 in deciles 7-9. It saturates rather than growing with the log-odds. With a2 in the fit, plain belief scores 0.717 and belief_lo scores 0.665. In the belief form the a2 and belief weights are about equal (+0.185 / -0.185), so the two cues count about the same. In the recorded form belief_lo is the main driver: belief_lo alone at D2 scores 0.641, a2 alone scores about 0.37.

The GO term '(phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * ep_dec' adds only about 0.013 on test (0.665 to 0.679). It is a fitted correction for a few late-episode windows, not a description. Even with it, misses still under-predicts GO after 'a2 S1 u' by +0.053 to +0.071, and in the worst windows the GO value is about 0.6-0.7 near trial 95-99 when the fit predicts 0.18.
The label leaves out an observed effect: z at D2 is higher after a rewarded previous trial (prev_reward weight +0.063, test gain about +0.03).

Remaining systematic errors with the best form: D2 after a rare previous trial is under-predicted after a2 S1 r (+0.071) and a2 S1 u (+0.040), and over-predicted after a1 S2 r (-0.055). Late-episode GO after a2 is still under-predicted. These are moderate; mean error by phase is about 0.
